capabilities.title: Dashboard
capabilities.description: Security posture, sensor health, alerts, and performance overview.

capabilities.title: Threats
capabilities.description: High-severity and user-verified items from Windows events, hardening, firewall, and persistence findings, with mark-false-positive, dismiss, reopen, and copy. Response actions (remediate, quarantine, kill, block, isolate, auto-remediation), browser scan, and reports remain unported.

capabilities.title: Remediation
capabilities.description: Track response actions, results, rollback, and audit history.

capabilities.title: Possible Threats
capabilities.description: Lower-severity items awaiting verification; Verify promotes to Threats, with dismiss and false-positive handling. (v29 never populated this list.) Intel lookup awaits DN-025.

capabilities.title: Processes
capabilities.description: Read-only live process inventory is available; lineage analysis and security signals remain to be ported.

capabilities.title: Drivers
capabilities.description: Loaded kernel driver inventory and path review are available. Package inventory, signature verification, and install/update/removal workflows remain unimplemented.

capabilities.title: Driver Packages
capabilities.description: Enumerates installed driver packages from the Windows Driver Store with INF file, version, class, provider, hardware IDs, and signature status.

capabilities.title: Network
capabilities.description: Live interface counters and bounded active TCP inventory are available; protocol events and detection remain unported.

capabilities.title: Security Events
capabilities.description: Read-only observations from fixed Windows event channels are available; event correlation, Sysmon/ETW sources, and detection workflows remain unported.

capabilities.title: Alerts
capabilities.description: Persistent deduplicated event-ID alerts with evidence references and local acknowledge/suppress triage state.

capabilities.title: File Inspector
capabilities.description: User-selected local PE static metadata and SHA-256 inspection; no malware verdict, signature verification, reputation, recursive scanning, or remediation.

capabilities.title: Threat Intelligence
capabilities.description: Live read-only CISA KEV catalog with bounded ingestion, search, provenance, source freshness, and explicit one-CVE EPSS lookup. Multi-feed correlation remains planned; local name candidates are in Vulnerabilities.

capabilities.title: Threat Intel Feeds
capabilities.description: On-demand malware URL feeds (URLhaus), C2 infrastructure (Feodo Tracker), malware samples (Malware Bazaar), and SSL/TLS fingerprints (SSL Blacklist) from Abuse.ch.

capabilities.title: Vulnerabilities
capabilities.description: Read-only installed application inventory and cautious CISA KEV product-name candidates; affected-version, patch, NVD/CVSS, CEV, and response workflows remain unimplemented.

capabilities.title: Hardening
capabilities.description: Read-only firmware and platform posture (v29 firmware_posture checks): BitLocker, Secure Boot, TPM, LSA protection, Credential Guard, VBS/HVCI, SMBv1, Windows Update. NSA/STIG hardening checks, compliance scoring, zero-day scan, and fix actions remain unported.

capabilities.title: Performance
capabilities.description: Live CPU, physical-memory, system-commit, OS-volume, active-adapter, and physical-disk throughput gauges; two-minute CPU/memory/commit/network/disk history; per-process CPU in the bounded process inventory; process/thread and TCP counts; uptime; volume space; largest working sets; bounded CSV export. Per-core CPU, pagefile storage usage, GPU, thermals, and power remain unported.

capabilities.title: Ransomware
capabilities.description: Behavioral ransomware detection, canaries, and recovery signals.

capabilities.title: Firewall
capabilities.description: Read-only profiles, rules with Downpour-rule identification, tamper findings (service stopped, profile off, risky inbound allows), and recent Event 5157 blocked connections. Rule toggle/delete, remove-all-Downpour-rules, and new-rule baseline alerts remain unported.

capabilities.title: Wi-Fi
capabilities.description: Read-only wireless posture: visible networks, Evil Twin detection, weak authentication (Open/WEP), attack tool OUIs, and paired Bluetooth device history. Radio disabling, interface disconnect, and deauth defense remain unported.

capabilities.title: DNS
capabilities.description: Read-only resolver cache inspection with Shannon entropy, consonant/digit ratios, bigram frequency scoring, risky TLD weighting, TOFU baseline, and passive SPF/DMARC/DKIM email record analysis. Cache clearing, hosts file editing, and active DNS tunneling defense remain unported.

capabilities.title: Project AEGIS
capabilities.description: Five-layer AEGIS protection architecture overview with fully local, zero-trust Layer 4 NLP phishing and social engineering text analyzer.

capabilities.title: Memory
capabilities.description: Memory analysis, injection indicators, and volatile evidence.

capabilities.title: Forensics
capabilities.description: Digital evidence collection with cryptographic SHA-256 chain of custody, security alert correlation, event logs, persistence anomalies, blocked connections, legal HTML incident reports, raw JSON bundle export, and FBI IC3 filing integration. Strictly read-only.

capabilities.title: Threat Hunt
capabilities.description: Persistence review: Run/RunOnce (incl. WOW64), Winlogon, startup folders, scheduled tasks incl. hidden, WMI subscriptions, DLL shadows in user-writable PATH folders, and driver files with BYOVD names, against a hash-only TOFU baseline. v29 hunt modes, LOLBin/process hunts, and response actions remain unported.

capabilities.title: Sandbox
capabilities.description: Safe file sandbox and static artifact analysis: Shannon entropy calculation, cryptographic checksums (SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5), PE structure and W^X violation detection, known packer identification, and Win32 API string pattern scoring (injection, evasion, spyware, C2). Host detonation disabled under least-privilege policy.

capabilities.title: Services
capabilities.description: Read-only Windows service inventory with current state and startup configuration.

capabilities.title: USB Devices
capabilities.description: Read-only USB device posture: removable drive inventory, autorun detection, device history (USBSTOR/USB), and BadUSB/attack tool hardware signatures. Device blocking, write protection, and autorun neutralizing remain unported.

capabilities.title: IoT Devices
capabilities.description: Device discovery, fingerprinting, and IoT risk indicators.

capabilities.title: Timeline
capabilities.description: Correlated and standalone security event timeline with automated attack pattern detection (brute force, persistence, account manipulation, service installs) and dark-themed executive HTML report export.

capabilities.title: Remote Access
capabilities.description: Read-only Remote Desktop state (enabled, NLA, port), TCP listeners and connections on v29 remote-access vector ports with owning processes, and running remote-access tools; high-confidence findings feed triage. Block-IP and vector hardening actions remain unported.

capabilities.title: Cleanup
capabilities.description: Read-only system and disk cleanup inspector: temporary directories (%TEMP%, Windows\Temp), WER error reports, thumbnail cache, crash dumps, Windows Update caches, and Recycle Bin space analysis with executive report export. Deletion actions disabled pending action broker (DN-008).

capabilities.title: VPN
capabilities.description: VPN state, DNS leak checks, and kill-switch status.

capabilities.title: Parental Controls
capabilities.description: Family safety settings, web filtering, and activity history.

capabilities.title: Emergency Response
capabilities.description: Emergency containment options and incident response workflows.

capabilities.title: Defense Suite
capabilities.description: Defense watcher status, alerts, and policy configuration.

capabilities.title: Tools
capabilities.description: Supporting diagnostics and security utilities.

capabilities.title: Settings
capabilities.description: Consolidated local preferences for weather visuals, reduced motion, and automatic storm cycling. Scanning, privacy-service, and response controls remain unported.

capabilities.title: Cognitive Immune System
capabilities.description: Self-healing analysis and adaptive defense status.
